mapper.sql: SELECT sv.id FROM story_versions sv JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND sv.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DRAFT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sv.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sv.version_number DESC, sv.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select:
WITH current_story AS (
) SELECT c.story_version_id, c.id AS chapter_id, c.order_index, c.title, c.row_version, c.source_hash, gj.media_plan_id, gj.media_plan_revision, COALESCE(mp.image_aspect_ratio, '16:9') AS aspect_ratio, narration.duration_ms AS audio_duration_ms, narration.storage_key AS audio_storage_key, narration.size_bytes AS audio_size_bytes, narration.checksum AS audio_checksum, narration.narration_request_id, narration.narration_asset_id, narration.narration_alignment_id, COALESCE( narration.duration_ms, NULLIF(c.estimated_duration_ms, 0), scene_duration.duration_ms, 0 ) AS fallback_duration_ms, COALESCE(plan_counts.beat_count, 0) AS beat_count, COALESCE(plan_counts.ready_beat_count, 0) AS ready_beat_count FROM chapters c JOIN current_story cs ON cs.id = c.story_version_id LEFT JOIN chapter_media_heads cmh ON cmh.chapter_id = c.id LEFT JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = cmh.generation_job_id LEFT JOIN media_plans mp ON mp.id = gj.media_plan_id AND mp.revision = gj.media_plan_revision AND mp.chapter_id = c.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nr.id AS narration_request_id, na.id AS narration_asset_id, alignment.id AS narration_alignment_id, pa.storage_key, na.size_bytes, na.checksum, na.duration_ms FROM narration_requests nr JOIN narration_assets na ON na.narration_request_id = nr.id JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nal.id FROM narration_alignments nal WHERE nal.narration_asset_id = na.id AND nal.source_hash = nr.source_hash ORDER BY nal.created_at DESC, nal.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) alignment ON TRUE WHERE nr.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND nr.chapter_id = c.id AND nr.chapter_row_version = c.row_version AND nr.source_hash = c.source_hash AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND na.duration_ms > 0 ORDER BY nr.created_at DESC, nr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) narration ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_seconds) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS duration_ms FROM scenes s WHERE s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id ) scene_duration ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS beat_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_generation_items mgi JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = mgi.media_asset_id WHERE mgi.media_plan_id = mbp.media_plan_id AND mgi.visual_beat_id = mbp.visual_beat_id AND mgi.execution_status = 'READY' AND ma.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL ) )::int AS ready_beat_count FROM media_beat_plans mbp WHERE mbp.media_plan_id = gj.media_plan_id ) plan_counts ON gj.media_plan_id IS NOT NULL WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.order_index ASC, c.id ASC

WITH current_story AS (
) SELECT c.id AS chapter_id, c.order_index AS chapter_order_index, mbp.scene_index, mbp.beat_index, mbp.visual_beat_id, COALESCE(vb.title, CONCAT('Beat ', mbp.beat_index + 1)) AS title, mbp.visual_intent, COALESCE(mbp.camera_movement, 'NONE') AS camera_movement, mbp.asset_strategy, mbp.audio_start_ms, mbp.audio_end_ms, mbp.audio_duration_ms, selected.media_asset_id, ma.storage_key, ma.size_bytes, ma.sha256 AS checksum FROM chapters c JOIN current_story cs ON cs.id = c.story_version_id JOIN chapter_media_heads cmh ON cmh.chapter_id = c.id JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = cmh.generation_job_id JOIN media_plans mp ON mp.id = gj.media_plan_id AND mp.revision = gj.media_plan_revision AND mp.chapter_id = c.id JOIN media_beat_plans mbp ON mbp.media_plan_id = mp.id LEFT JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = mbp.visual_beat_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mgi.media_asset_id FROM media_generation_items mgi WHERE mgi.media_plan_id = mbp.media_plan_id AND mgi.visual_beat_id = mbp.visual_beat_id AND mgi.execution_status = 'READY' AND mgi.media_asset_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mgi.attempt_number DESC, mgi.created_at DESC, mgi.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) selected ON TRUE LEFT JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = selected.media_asset_id AND ma.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.order_index ASC, c.id ASC, mbp.scene_index ASC, mbp.beat_index ASC
